newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Electricidad de Caracas doubts quick rate rise, ADR.
newsitem.headline: Electricidad de Caracas doubts quick rate rise, ADR.

text.p: Leading Venezuelan utility and stock market bellwether Electricidad de Caracas is unlikely to issue American Depository Receipts (ADRs) in the near future, and doubts it will be awarded a tariff increase soon, a company source said.
"Although we've considered doing that (issuing ADRs) for a long while, we don't believe now is the moment," said the highly placed source, who asked not to be identified.

As for long-awaited increases in electricity tariffs, pending approval by Venezuela's regulatory body the CREE, the company executive added: "They haven't told us anything recently. I don't think the increase will be in February."

Market rumors Electricidad would finally go ahead with the ADR issue on an increase in electricity tariffs firmed the stock Tuesday 11.00 bolivars. But the share price dropped back 5.00 bolivar to end at 532.50 after Wednesday's session.
